svg.title: Four Checks Before Committing the Estate
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-and-risk-routing; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before Committing the Estate; subtitle: A sequential yes-or-redirect decision path, documented in the transaction file.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: California is the statutory example; replace it with the property's applicable law and actual court orders. Numeric values indicate check sequence, not probabilities or a measure of legal sufficiency.; caption: Proceed only along a documented transaction path. Missing authority, unresolved objections, and conflicting interests change the workflow; they are not problems that automation can waive.; stages: label: Authority and sale route; value: Verified authority: continue; missing authority: return to counsel; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Inspect appointment documents and current orders. California Probate Code section 10501 distinguishes full from limited independent-administration authority; limited-authority real property sales require the applicable court-supervised route.; label: Licensing and referral economics; value: Permitted role: continue; prohibited compensation: restructure engagement; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Confirm brokerage licensing under California Business and Professions Code section 10130. Screen covered referral arrangements under 12 U.S.C. section 2607 and 12 CFR section 1024.14; do not pay for prohibited steering.; label: Notices, objections, and closing readiness; value: Requirements satisfied: continue; unresolved conditions: suspend closing commitments; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Have counsel identify applicable notice duties under California Probate Code section 10580 and the effect of any objection. Resolve title exceptions, occupancy, and required court action before committing to a closing date.; label: Conflicts and principal acquisitions; value: Independent review completed: proceed; unresolved conflict: separate transaction paths; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document buyer affiliations and agency interests. California Probate Code section 9880 restricts representative purchases subject to statutory exceptions. Route affiliated acquisitions for counsel review; brokerage disclosures alone may be insufficient.

rect.title: label: Authority and sale route; value: Verified authority: continue; missing authority: return to counsel; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Inspect appointment documents and current orders. California Probate Code section 10501 distinguishes full from limited independent-administration authority; limited-authority real property sales require the applicable court-supervised route.

text.title: Inspect appointment documents and current orders. California Probate Code section 10501 distinguishes full from limited independent-administration authority; limited-authority real property sales require the applicable court-supervised route.

rect.title: label: Licensing and referral economics; value: Permitted role: continue; prohibited compensation: restructure engagement; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Confirm brokerage licensing under California Business and Professions Code section 10130. Screen covered referral arrangements under 12 U.S.C. section 2607 and 12 CFR section 1024.14; do not pay for prohibited steering.

text.title: Confirm brokerage licensing under California Business and Professions Code section 10130. Screen covered referral arrangements under 12 U.S.C. section 2607 and 12 CFR section 1024.14; do not pay for prohibited steering.

rect.title: label: Notices, objections, and closing readiness; value: Requirements satisfied: continue; unresolved conditions: suspend closing commitments; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Have counsel identify applicable notice duties under California Probate Code section 10580 and the effect of any objection. Resolve title exceptions, occupancy, and required court action before committing to a closing date.

text.title: Have counsel identify applicable notice duties under California Probate Code section 10580 and the effect of any objection. Resolve title exceptions, occupancy, and required court action before committing to a closing date.

rect.title: label: Conflicts and principal acquisitions; value: Independent review completed: proceed; unresolved conflict: separate transaction paths; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Document buyer affiliations and agency interests. California Probate Code section 9880 restricts representative purchases subject to statutory exceptions. Route affiliated acquisitions for counsel review; brokerage disclosures alone may be insufficient.

Assumptions: California is the statutory example; replace it with the property's applicable law and actual court orders. Numeric values indicate check sequence, not probabilities or a measure of legal sufficiency.
